name: Healing Herbs
effectText: Heal 1, or Throw away a Wound card from your discard pile.

name: Tome of Relearning
effectText: On your turn, when not in combat, you may swap one of your skills for another in the common skills area.

name: Fire Gem
effectText: Add the Fire element to an attack or block from a single action card.

name: Ice Shard
effectText: Add the Ice element to an attack or block from a single action card.

name: Cloak of Shielding
effectText: Once, when your Hero is about to be wounded, you may ignore one Wound and any additional effects from it.

name: Mystical Map
effectText: During your movement, reveal a new tile at a distance of up to 3 spaces. This costs no movement.

name: Vampiric Chalice
effectText: After combat this turn, for each enemy you defeated you may discard a Wound (to a maximum of 4).

name: Amulet of Reawakening
effectText: Pick a card at random from your discard pile and put it on the bottom of your Deed Deck. At the end of your turn, draw as if your Hand Limit is 1 higher.

name: Vial of Toxin
effectText: One source of physical attack gains +3 (+2 in ranged, +1 in siege). This bonus is lost if the attack is no longer physical.

name: Ghostly Elixir
effectText: One attack on a single action card becomes ranged attack.

name: Orb of Twilight
effectText: You may change one Black mana die in the source to Gold, or one Gold mana die in the source to Black.

name: Staff of Concealment
effectText: Move 2. Your movement does not provoke rampaging enemies or enemies with ambush this turn. Also, any enemies pursuing you are not moved and do not attack you this turn.

name: Cloak of the Martyr
effectText: Choose one Unit. It may be assigned damage during combat this turn even if it is Wounded or has already been assigned damage once during this combat. After assigning damage to it, destroy it.

name: Mask of Fear
effectText: Reduce one enemy attack by 2. You may not use regular (Silver) units for the remainder of this combat.

name: Blade of Dominance
effectText: Spend an amount of Attack. One enemy with total attack(s) equal to or less than this amount does not attack this turn.

name: Blood Fury Dagger
effectText: For each Wound you take from one enemy's attack(s), get Attack 2 during your Attack phase, to a maximum of 6 Attack.

name: Ring of Shadows
effectText: During the Assign Damage Phase, ignore all wounds (and any additional effects from them) from one enemy's attack(s). Ignore all Fame gained and Reputation gained & lost for the remainder of this combat.

name: Boot of Charging
effectText: Move 2. You must use this to move into a space adjacent to a rampaging enemy and you must fight that enemy this turn. Get Attack 2 in the attack phase which you may only use against that enemy.

name: Binding Contract
effectText: Get a discount of 2 towards the cost of recruiting one Unit. You may discard one card or mana crystal to increase the discount to 4.

name: Helm of Mind Shielding
effectText: Psychic Block 2. This turn, your Block (but not your Units') is Psychic Block in addition to its other type(s).

name: Mask of Impersonation
effectText: When you are about to lose Reputation, reduce the Reputation loss by 1 and you may give another player Reputation -1.

name: Scroll of Seeking
effectText: If you are interacting at an inhabited site, you may recruit one Unit as if at any site. If you are not at an inhabited site, as your action this turn you may interact to recruit one Unit as if at a village.

name: Tome of Trading
effectText: On your turn, when not in combat, you may swap an Advanced Action or Spell in your hand with one of the same color in the corresponding offer.

name: Aura Gauntlet
effectText:
Choose a basic mana color shown on a die in the Source and gain the benefit:
Blue - Block 2
Green - Heal 1
Red - Attack 2
White - Influence 2
